notes: G8 evaluation contract (ADR-0008 §4, G8.1-clarified). G8 freezes 3-5 rights-cleared evaluation CASES; at G8, non-overlapping bounded windows from one verified rights-cleared source are the permitted safe minimum. They freeze the harness, provenance and rubric, NOT corpus diversity. Multiple distinct rights-cleared source clips are a v0.2 benchmark requirement and require owner/licence review before addition.
